subject: Private deployment: license tiers, token economics — recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@meridian.com>, Lauren Chang <lchang@procureit.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment: license tiers, token economics — recap & next steps

Hi Jordan / Lauren —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery + the specific asks we promised to follow up on so procurement can evaluate options quickly: 

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Use case: clinical triage assistant (patient intake + clinician summarization).
- Expected traffic profile: steady baseline with daily peaks during business hours.
- Compliance: SOC 2 required, PHI in scope (customer-managed keys preferred).

Data we need to finalize pricing options (please confirm or adjust):
1) Monthly token volume (input + output) — ballpark or range.
2) Peak concurrency / QPS (or requests per minute) for sizing.
3) Number of environments to license (prod/stage/dev/sandbox).
4) Target budget range for license + infra (monthly) and any internal $/1M-token target.
5) Preferred support tier (standard vs. premium / 24x7).
6) Timeline for pilot and procurement window.

What we recommend as next steps (we attached two artifacts):
- token-econ-template.csv (attached): fill monthly tokens and peak rows so we can produce unit econ.
- license-tiers-summary.pdf (attached): draft license models and support tiers (flat fee + committed tokens OR committed tokens with per-token overage).

Initial questions we can answer now:
- If you have a target $/1M tokens you want to hit for budgeting, tell us and we can map to an annual commitment that meets it. Example: committed 60M tokens/year can get you into the ~$600-$700 per 1M tokens range depending on support and VPC options.

Would you be able to return the token-econ-template with best-effort numbers by EOD Mon (9/21)? We’ll produce a short-compare quote and a 2-week pilot SOW draft.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0138

Attachments: token-econ-template.csv (stub), license-tiers-summary.pdf (stub)

From: Jordan Myers <jordan@meridian.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: license tiers, token economics — recap & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side (high level; will confirm in the CSV):

1) Monthly tokens: currently estimating ~50M tokens/month (input + output combined) for year 1 projected usage. There's a growth curve — expect 15–25% q/q if pilot succeeds.
2) Peaks: ~150 requests/minute during weekday spikes; average request size ~300 tokens.
3) Environments: 3 (prod, staging, sandbox) — prod needs high availability; staging can be lower.
4) Budget: internal target is $30k–$60k/month total (license + infra). If you can show options that achieve ~$600–$800 per 1M tokens with reasonable committed terms, that lands in our range.
5) Support: premium (24x7) and a named SL for escalation.
6) Timeline: pilot target start ~first week of Oct; procurement review week of Sep 27.

Procurement (cc'ed procurement@meridian.com) will want an initial SOW + MSA redline window. Lauren — can you confirm any PO/contracting constraints we should be aware of?

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Product, Meridian HealthTech
jordan@meridian.com | +1 646-555-9911

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Private deployment: license tiers, token economics — recap & next steps

Marissa / Neha — quick pricing guidance based on Jordan's numbers:

Options to present (short-form):
- Option A — Reserved license + infra: Annual license fee + reserved GPU capacity. Pricing example for Meridian assumptions (50M/mo -> ~600M/year): license $180k/yr + committed throughput block that equates to roughly $650 per 1M tokens effective (with 10% discount at 12-month commit). Premium support add-on $35k/yr.
- Option B — Committed tokens w/ overage: Commit 500M tokens/year at $700 per 1M tokens; overage at $850 per 1M. Premium support included in higher tier.
- Option C — Short pilot (2-week) — minimal license, pay per-token at $1,250 per 1M for pilot usage; converts to committed rates on signed contract.

Notes: Private/VPC adds baseline infra uplift (networking, KMS integration) that we normally amortize into license for Dedicated customers — call that $8k–$15k one-time depending on region and vault integration complexity. Environment count impacts entitlements (we bill prod vs. non-prod differently).

I'll attach updated pricing workbook (pricing-ark-v2.xlsx) and can run the exact $/1M token for the fills you get me in the CSV. If their target is $600/1M, we should aim to show Option A at that effective rate with a 12–24 month commit.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Private deployment: license tiers, token economics — recap & next steps

Jordan / Lauren — attached is a short mutual action plan (MAP-Meridian-HealthTech-20260918.pdf) and a draft 2-week pilot SOW. Highlights:
- Pilot scope: dedicated VPC with SOC2 controls enabled, named SL, pre-provisioned dev/prod/staging environments (prod sized for 2x baseline load).
- Commercial options: mapped Option A/B from Ben to the Meridian numbers you provided; the MAP calls out the committed token band that would achieve ~$650 per 1M tokens.
- Next steps & timing: Procurement review week of 9/27; pilot kickoff target week of 10/4; quote delivered by 9/22.

Action items for Jordan / procurement: please confirm the token rows in token-econ-template.csv and confirm that 3 environments is accurate. Lauren — any contracting windows or PO terms we should align to?

I can turn the MAP into a formal quote + SOW once we have the filled CSV.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: MAP-Meridian-HealthTech-20260918.pdf (stub)

Marissa — appreciate this turnaround. We will populate the token-econ-template and send back by EOD today. A few clarifications before procurement:

- Confirm pilot pricing: 2-week pilot at $1,250 per 1M tokens as you suggested for short pilots, with a conversion credit if we move to a committed contract.
- Support: premium + named SL ok — procurement wants escalation SLA language in the SOW.
- Environments: confirmed 3 (prod/stage/sandbox). Prod must be HA across two AZs.

Procurement will want the initial quote and MSA redline window (we typically request 10 business days). If you can deliver a formal quote + redline-friendly MSA by 9/22, we can target kickoff week of 10/4.

I'll loop back once the CSV is complete. Thanks —
Jordan
